items.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
items.summary:
GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this:

In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count.

items.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says he is in therapy, as comeback rally fades
items.summary:
Jensen Huang apologised to Nvidia staff and said he was in therapy on Tuesday, as a stock rally triggered by his shock return as CEO faltered amid persistent doubts over the probes he faces and the fate of the AI investment boom.
“I made some terrible mistakes,” Huang told an hour-long all-hands meeting at the company’s Santa Clara, California, headquarters, The New York Times reported after reviewing a live stream of the event.
He told staff it was “not acceptable” that he had broken a code of.
